definitions.explanation: The practice of predicting the future or reading a person's fate through various methods such as astrology, palm reading, tarot cards, etc. Also refers to the result of such a reading.

examples.japanese: {占|うらな}いを{信|しん}じますか。
{今朝|けさ}のテレビの{占|うらな}いで{一位|いちい}だった。
examples.english: I was ranked first in this morning's TV horoscope.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{原宿|はらじゅく}で{占|うらな}いをしてもらった。
examples.english: My friend and I had our fortunes told in Harajuku.

notes:
{占|うらな}い is derived from the verb {占|うらな}う (to tell fortunes). It covers all forms of fortune-telling and divination.

TYPES OF {占|うらな}い:
- {星占|ほしうらな}い: astrology, horoscope
- {手相|てそう}{占|うらな}い: palm reading
- タロット{占|うらな}い: tarot reading
- {血液型|けつえきがた}{占|うらな}い: blood type fortune-telling (popular in Japan)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {占|うらな}い{師|し}: fortune-teller
- {占|うらな}いをしてもらう: to have one's fortune told
- {占|うらな}いを{信|しん}じる: to believe in fortune-telling
- {今日|きょう}の{占|うらな}い: today's horoscope

CULTURAL NOTE:
Morning TV shows in Japan commonly feature daily horoscope segments. {血液型|けつえきがた}{占|うらな}い (blood type personality reading) is a uniquely popular form of fortune-telling in Japan.
